title: Learn the technical landscape
summary: Understand the systems behind the product, their constraints and the technical debt, so you can plan realistically.

beginner: Ask an engineer to draw the main systems and how they connect.
Learn which systems are owned by other teams.
Ask about the biggest technical risks and debt.
Learn how releases work and how often.
Note constraints that will affect your plans.
experienced: Assess technical strategy and its fit with product strategy.
Agree technical health priorities with engineering.

toolExamples.github: Read the README and architecture notes.
toolExamples.miro: Redraw the architecture and check it with engineers.

pitfalls: Skipping it because you are not technical
